outpatient.description: Some insurance plans may cover DHA-approved medications as prescribed by a practitioner for certain conditions. The coverage level and contribution to costs varies based on the plan selected.

Most insurance plans typically cover treatments involving muscular-skeletal conditions with physiotherapy sessions. Comprehensive plans typically offer more extensive coverage for these treatments, including more frequent and higher level sessions.

These benefits may include coverage for prescription eyeglasses, contact lenses, and vision exams.

exclusion.description: Treatments and services arising as a result including but not limited to, any form of aerial flight, any kind of power-vehicle race, water sports, horse riding activities, mountaineering activities, violent sports such as judo, boxing, and wrestling, bungee jumping and any professional sports activities.

exclusion.text: Any Services related to birth defects, congenital conditions and deformities

exclusion.description: All cosmetic healthcare services and services associated with replacement of an existing breast implant. regionCover.description: Insurance policies are typically limited to coverage for a specific Emirate, the UAE, GCC countries, or overseas countries as well (outside of the UAE/GCC). The exact geographical scope of coverage depends on the insurance policy purchased.

maternityCover.description: The insured member is typically responsible for paying the policy excess, which is usually a fixed percentage or specified value of the overall cost of the claim. This can be an addition to any standard policy excess applicable as well.

maternityCover.description: Outpatient visits and tests for pregnancy are typically covered under insurance policies, subject to DHA's antenatal care protocols and policy terms & conditions.

outpatient.description: Some insurance plans may cover DHA-approved medications as prescribed by a practitioner for certain conditions. The coverage level and contribution to costs varies based on the plan selected.
A company that provides specified administrative services on behalf of the Insurance Company.

Medical consultation fees, following a referral from a doctor or general practitioner, may be covered by some insurance plans, subject to the terms and conditions of the plan. The costs of diagnostic tests recommended by your doctor such as Blood Tests, X-Rays, MRIs, Urinalysis, etc. maybe covered by your chosen plan.

Alternative medicine and treatments refer to any form of medical practice or healthcare that does not fall within the scope of conventional medicine. Examples of alternative medicine and treatments include homeopathy, acupuncture, and chiropractic. Most health insurance policies typically do not cover alternative medicines or treatments, which can require an additional premium for coverage.

Most insurance plans typically cover treatments involving muscular-skeletal conditions with physiotherapy sessions. Comprehensive plans typically offer more extensive coverage for these treatments, including more frequent and higher level sessions.
Dental benefit typically covers routine check-ups, cleanings, x-rays and dental treatments such as fillings and crowns. Orthodontics such as braces may only be covered in higher plans.
These benefits may include coverage for prescription eyeglasses, contact lenses, and vision exams.

exclusion.text: Any services related to birth defects, congenital conditions and deformities

exclusion.description: Treatments and services arising as a result including but not limited to, any form of aerial flight, any kind of power-vehicle race, water sports, horse riding activities, mountaineering activities, violent sports such as judo, boxing, and wrestling, bungee jumping and any professional sports activities.

All cosmetic healthcare services and services associated with replacement of an existing breast implant. Cosmetic operations which are related to an Injury, sickness or congenital anomaly when the primary purpose is to improve physiological functioning of the involved part of the body and breast reconstruction following a mastectomy for cancer are covered.

Alternative medicine and treatments refer to any form of medical practice or healthcare that does not fall within the scope of conventional medicine. Examples of alternative medicine and treatments include homeopathy, acupuncture, and chiropractic. Most health insurance policies typically do not cover alternative medicines or treatments, which can require an additional premium for coverage.

Most insurance plans typically cover treatments involving muscular-skeletal conditions with physiotherapy sessions. Comprehensive plans typically offer more extensive coverage for these treatments, including more frequent and higher level sessions.
Dental benefit typically covers routine check-ups, cleanings, x-rays and dental treatments such as fillings and crowns. Orthodontics such as braces may only be covered in higher plans.
outpatient.value: USD 1,350 - (Major dental treatment covered with 6 months waiting period)

outpatient.description: These benefits may include coverage for prescription eyeglasses, contact lenses, and vision exams.

exclusion.text: Any services related to birth defects, congenital conditions and deformities

exclusion.description: Treatments and services arising as a result including but not limited to, any form of aerial flight, any kind of power-vehicle race, water sports, horse riding activities, mountaineering activities, violent sports such as judo, boxing, and wrestling, bungee jumping and any professional sports activities.

All cosmetic healthcare services and services associated with replacement of an existing breast implant. Cosmetic operations which are related to an Injury, sickness or congenital anomaly when the primary purpose is to improve physiological functioning of the involved part of the body and breast reconstruction following a mastectomy for cancer are covered.
